headline: [News Analysis] Amid Blame on Real Estate and Leveraged Products… Kim Yong-beom Resigns Just Two Days After Cabinet Reshuffle
summary: Kim Yong-beom, Cheong Wa Dae policy chief who led the Lee Jae-myung government's economic policy, resigned on the 1st. The move follows public criticism over real estate and single-stock leveraged products.
why: Economic policy leadership in South Korea shapes regulation of real estate and leveraged investment products that affect domestic markets.
